title: Dyed Items Tab
body:
Should Disorder of the Stone have a dyed items tab? Currently, there's 32 Wool, Carpets, and Glass, and in the future, Glass Slabs and Stairs may be added.
Every dyed item is in the Building Blocks tab right now.

![image: Dyed Items Tab](media/1439052412764688404.png)

**Update (December 27, 2025):** Dyed Items Tab has been added to Disorder of the Stone.
